0.body: He cyanobacteria a Synechocystis, kāore he pokapū i roto i te pūtau. Ka ora i te rama: ka whakaputa hāora, kāore he chloroplast. He tauira noa i te taiwhanga mō te mahi hāowhā.

1.body: He taura pūtau tā Anabaena variabilis. Ka huri ētahi pūtau hei heterocyst, ka here i te hāota; ko ōna hoa te mahi huka. I te roto, ka tuku hāota kua herea.

2.body: He pīrori pūtau a Spirulina (Arthrospira) me ngā pouaka hau. Ka noho ki te tihi o te wai, ka mahi i te rama, ā, ka kaihia. I te kēmu, he pīrori kākāriki nui i te mata o te wai.

3.body: He taura poi iti a Nostoc punctiforme i roto i tētahi kōpaki whē. Ka noho wehe noa, rānei ka noho tahi me ngā tipu. He rite te kāhui ki tētahi pokeka poi kākāriki.

4.body: He taura neke a Oscillatoria limnetica. Ka takahuri ki ngā taha e rua, ā, ka taea te mahi i te rama me te kore e tuku hāora. He nō te parapara me te kiri o te wai.

5.body: He kāhui whē a Microcystis aeruginosa, ā, he nui noa atu tōna matū kino (microcystin). Ka piki tōna nui i te tihi o te wai. I te kēmu, he poi kākāriki te kāhui — he kai, engari he mōrearea.

6.body: He takirua pūtau a Gloeocapsa i roto i ngā kākahu tae. Ka noho i ngā toka me te oneone; ka āhei te UV. I te roto, he pūtau porohita iti e takirua ana i roto i tētahi kōpaki.

7.body: He taura cyanobacteria mātōtoru a Lyngbya majuscula. Ka taea e ia te tuku i tētahi matū kino e whakawerawera ana i te kiri. Ka hanga whāriki i ngā tahatahi mahana.

8.body: He pūtau kākāriki a Chlamydomonas reinhardtii me ōna whiore e rua me tētahi karu iti. Ka kau atu ki te rama. He tauira rongonui mō te pūtaiao ira o te rimurapa.

9.body: He poi kākāriki a Chlorella vulgaris, kāore e neke. Ka wehe tere, he nui te pūmua. He kai mō ngā kaiiti, ā, he kaupapa noa mō te kai ā-ātea.

10.body: He poi whai kōhao a Volvox globator, he mano rawa ngā pūtau. Ka pakeke ngā kāhui tamahine i roto, kātahi ka puta atu. I te kēmu, he kāhui kākāriki nui.

11.body: He kai-rua a Euglena gracilis: he chloroplast, ā, ka taea anō te kai. He karu whero e ārahi ana i te rama. He kākāriki i te awatea; i te pō, ka huri ki te kai.

12.body: He whā pūtau a Scenedesmus quadricauda e raupapa ana, he tara ki ngā pito. Ko ngā tara ka whakatamarū i te horomi. Kāore e kau — ka mānu noa.

13.body: He pūtau kākāriki e neke ana a Haematococcus pluvialis; i te raru, ka whero (astaxanthin), ā, ka hanga he taiepa mātōtoru. Ka ora ngā kōpaki whero i ngā wā kore ua.

14.body: Kāore he taiepa mārō a Dunaliella salina, ā, ka noho i te wai tino totē. Ka penapena i te beta-carotene; he karaka te ahua. He whiore e rua.

15.body: He whetū papatahi a Micrasterias rotata. E rua ngā haurua e rite ana ki te whakaata, me ngā tapae hōhonu. Kāore e neke; ka mahi i te rama i te wai kawa o te repo.

16.body: He diatom āhua waka a Navicula me tētahi anga silica. Ka neke i te pūtake i te taha o tētahi kōhao raphe. Ka toe te anga i muri i te matenga.

17.body: He diatom nui a Pinnularia viridis, he āhua huruhuru. He anga silica, he tauira rite tonu. Ka neke pōturi i te papa o te wai.

18.body: He diatom porohita a Cyclotella meneghiniana. Ka mānu hei kōpae; ko te anga, he taupoki e rua. He plankton noa.

19.body: He diatom a Diatoma vulgare e tūhono ana hei rārangi zigzag. Ka whakatamarūtia te neketanga o te kāhui i roto i te wai.

20.body: He pīrori waiporoporo a Rhodospirillum rubrum. Ka mahi i te rama me te kore e tuku hāora, ā, ka kai i ngā matū hangaora. Nō te bacteriochlorophyll tōna whero.

21.body: He huakita waiporoporo, nō te kōpura, a Chromatium vinosum. Ka whakamahi i te hydrogen sulfide, ā, ka penapena i ngā poi kōpura. Ka noho i te rohe o te hāora me te kōpura.

22.body: He rimurapa whero tētahi-pūtau a Porphyridium cruentum. Ko te phycoerythrin te mea whakaputa i te whero rite ki te toto. He kōpaki whē, kāore he whiore.

23.body: Ko Prochlorococcus marinus te pūtau mahi-rama iti rawa me te nui rawa o te whenua. I kitea i ngā tau 1980. Ko ia tētahi whangainga nui mō te moana.

24.body: He moroi noho-tino a Chroococcidiopsis thermalis: koraha, toka, iraruke. He tētahi kaitoho mō te oranga i waho i Papatūānuku. I te roto, he kāhui pūtau porohita pōturi.

25.body: He kaihoro huakita iti a Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus. Ka pīrori tomo atu ki tētahi pūtau ke, ā, ka nui haere tae noa ki te pakaru o te kaiwhakaruruhau.

26.body: Ka noho a Vampirococcus ki waho o tōna kai, ka tomi i ngā mea o roto me te kore e tomo. He huakita ahua kaitoto.

27.body: Ka tomo a Daptobacter ki roto i te huakita kai, ka kai i a ia mai i roto. He kaihoro roto-pūtau, he mea uaua rawa te kite.

28.body: He huakita tōpū a Myxococcus xanthus. He ngātahi, ka karapinepine i te kai, ka tuku i ngā enzyme. I te kore kai, ka hanga i tētahi tinana hua.

29.body: He whanaunga moana a Bacteriovorax stolpii nō te Bdellovibrio. Ka whakaeke ki ngā Gram-negative, ā, ka noho i te periplasm o tōna kai.

30.body: He kaihoro huakita a Halobacteriovorax e āhei ana ki te totē. He ai rite tonu: ka tīhore i te taiepa, kātahi ka tipu i roto.

31.body: He kaihoro BALO anō a Peredibacter starrii. He tere, he āhua piko, e aronui ana ki ngā huakita roa.

32.body: He pūtau whiore iti a Monas guttula, e kai ana i ētahi atu. Ka hopu i ngā huakita i te mata o te parapara.

33.body: He pūtau whiore āhua wai-taka a Oikomonas termo. Kotahi anō tōna whiore; ka kaihoro i roto i te kiri huakita o te wai.

34.body: He kāhui a Anthophysa vegetans i runga i tētahi pou rino-manganese. Ka noho tahi ngā pūtau ki tētahi topū, ka hopu i ngā huakita.

35.body: He cryptophyte kāore he tae a Chilomonas paramecium. E rua ngā whiore; ka kai i ngā matū hangaora kua rea me ngā huakita iti; kāore he chloroplast.

36.body: He amoeba-whiore a Cercomonas longicauda, he whiore roa tāna. Ka neke pōturi, ka horomi i ngā huakita mā ōna waewae teka.

37.body: He whiore oneone a Heteromita globosa. E rua ngā whiore, he rerekē te roa; ko ia tētahi kaihuakita matua o te oneone.

38.body: He kinetoplastid a Bodo saltans. Ka 'kanikani' noa i tōna wāhi, e piri ana mā tōna whiore tuauru, ā, ka hopu tere i ngā huakita.

39.body: He whanaunga a Procryptobia sorokini nō te Bodo. Ka kau wehe noa, ā, ka papā i te kai mā tōna whiore mua.

40.body: He kainoho toto a Trypanosoma brucei e whakaputa ana i te mate moe. He membrane nekeneke, kotahi te whiore. I te roto, he tauira noa mō te kaihoro whāiti.

41.body: He kainoho roto-pūtau a Leishmania donovani o te tangata. He whiore i roto i te ngārara; kāore he whiore i roto i te macrophage.

42.body: He choanoflagellate a Monosiga brevicollis, he whanaunga noa o ngā kararehe. He kaki microvilli tōna, e tātari ana i ngā huakita.

43.body: He choanoflagellate piri a Salpingoeca rosetta, i roto i tētahi anga. Ka taea te hanga i tētahi āhua putiputi kōpae. Ka tātari i te ia o te wai.

44.body: He kāhui choanoflagellate a Codonosiga botrytis i runga i tētahi pou kotahi. Tokomaha ngā kaitātari i runga i te pou kotahi.

45.body: Ko Paramecium caudatum te parahua rongonui. He mano ōna makawe, he awa waha, ā, he pouaka wai e kukune ana. Ka tātari i ngā huakita.

46.body: He parahua a Paramecium bursaria me ōna hoa noho zoochlorella. He kākāriki i roto: he huka mai i te rimurapa i te awatea, he tātari i te pō.

47.body: He pūtētē kikorangi a Stentor coeruleus, tae rawa atu ki te millimetre. Ka whakarahi ake hei ngongo, ā, ka whakahaere i te ia wai mā ngā makawe. Ka taea te kau, ka taea anō te noho.

48.body: He whanaunga a Stentor polymorphus nō te pūtētē kikorangi, ā, he nui noa ngā zoochlorella. Ka huri tōna āhua mai i te pūtētē ki te poi.

49.body: He āhua kopa a Vorticella campanula kei runga i tētahi pou e kukune ana. Ka pīrori te pou hei tōrino i te tino poto rawa o te wā. Kāore te pūtau e kau wehe atu.

50.body: He kopa iti a Vorticella microstoma. Ko te pou pērā anō, engari he whāiti ake te wā waha. He nō te parapara noa.

51.body: He kaihoro 'hue' a Didinium nasutum mō ngā parahua. Ka tuku toxicysts, ā, ka horomi i te kai katoa, ahakoa nui ake i a ia.

52.body: He porohita roa rawa a Spirostomum ambiguum. Ka kukune ia maha tāpiritanga i te taha iti rawa o tētahi hēkene. He rārangi pīrori ōna makawe.

53.body: He ciliate māwhero a Blepharisma americanum. Ko tōna pigment blepharismin he rongo rama. Ka tātari i te kai, ā, ka taea hoki te whakaeke ki ngā pūtau iti ake.

54.body: Ka haere a Euplotes patella i runga i ōna cirri, pērā i te haere i runga waewae. He papatahi, ka tahuri tere. Ka keri i ngā huakita i runga i ngā mata.

55.body: He hypotrich a Stylonychia pustulata e 'oma ana' i te papa. He cirri nui, he waha mārama. He kaihoro mō ngā ciliate iti.

56.body: He tauira genome a Oxytricha trifallax: e rua ōna pokapū pūtau, ā, he mātua rawa ōna tuhi anō i te DNA. Ka haere i ōna cirri; ka kai i ngā huakita me ngā protist iti.

57.body: He ciliate taiwhanga a Tetrahymena thermophila. E whā ngā membranelle o te waha, he wehe tere. He tauira mō ngā telomere me ngā makawe.

58.body: He āhua hue a Coleps hirtus, he papa kōhatu me ngā tara. He kai parapara, he kaihoro anō: ka ngau tonu i ngā mea tūroro.

59.body: He kaihoro papatahi a Litonotus lamella me ngā toxicysts i tōna waha roa. Ka whakakore i te neke o tōna kai, kātahi ka tomi i a ia.

60.body: He kaki roa a Dileptus anser me ngā extrusomes kino. Ka papā mā te kaki, kātahi ka horomi i te kai. He kaihoro nui o te taumata waenga.

61.body: He pōtaka a Urocentrum turbo: he tari makawe kei te waenga e porotaka ana i te pūtau ki tōna wāhi noa. Ka tātari i ngā huakita.

62.body: He kāhui kopa a Zoothamnium arbuscula, he rākau manga manga. Ko tētahi pou kukune, kotahi mā te katoa, ka unu i te rākau katoa i te wā kotahi.

63.body: He peritrich piri a Opercularia coarctata, kāore he pou peke. He taupoki kei runga i tōna waha. Ka tātari noa, kāore e kau wehe.

64.body: Ko Amoeba proteus te amoeba rongonui. Ka karapoti i te kai mā ōna waewae teka. Kāore he āhua pūmau, kāore he makawe.

65.body: He amoeba whai anga mārō a Arcella vulgaris, he porohita te āhua. Ka puta ōna waewae teka i te kōhao. Ka neke noa i runga i ngā tipu.

66.body: He anga tō Difflugia oblonga, hangaia mai i ngā toka one iti, ka piriwhakapiri ake anō e ia. Ka noho i te parapara.

67.body: He anga silica a Euglypha alveolata, hangaia mai i ngā papa paku. He waewae teka tīwaiwai tāna. He kaihoro huakita iti.

68.body: He anga āhua hue tā Nebela collaris, hangaia mai i ngā papa paku kua tahae. He nō ngā wai ngahere me ngā repo.

69.body: He anga kōpae whai tara a Centropyxis aculeata. Kāore te kōhao i te waenganui, kei tētahi taha. Ka neke i runga i te parapara.

70.body: He heliozoan a Actinophrys sol: he axopodia tīwaiwai e whitiwhiti ana ki ngā taha katoa. Ka piri te kai ki ērā rā, kātahi ka unuhia ki roto.

71.body: He heliozoan nui a Actinosphaerium eichhorni, he pokapū maha. He rā pērā anō, he nui rawa ake te pūtau. Ka kai i ngā ciliate me ngā rotifer.

72.body: He heliozoan a Raphidiophrys pallida, kei roto i ngā papa paku. He ngira silica ōna rā. He kaihoro taupa mō te plankton.

73.body: He rotifer a Rotaria rotatoria, ka āhei te ora i ngā wā maroke. He karauna e neke neke ana, ka kawea te kai ki te waha. He kararehe maha-pūtau tūturu.

74.body: He rotifer bdeloid māwhero a Philodina roseola. Ka rēti noa, ka kau anō hoki. He uwha anō; kāore he tāne.

75.body: He rotifer plankton whai anga a Brachionus plicatilis. He kai mō ngā ika pēpi i ngā whakatipu ika. Ka tātari i ngā rimurapa me ngā huakita.

76.body: He rotifer a Keratella cochlearis me tētahi tara roa o te anga. Ko te tara ka whakawehi i ngā kaihoro. He plankton roto tēnei, he nō runga noa.

77.body: He pēke kāore he anga a Asplanchna priodonta, he rotifer kaihoro. Ka horomi katoatia i ētahi atu rotifer me ngā ciliate.

78.body: He gastrotrich a Chaetonotus maximus. He kiri papa paku, ka neke i te papa o te wai. Ka kai i ngā huakita me te parapara.

79.body: He gastrotrich iti a Lepidodermella squamata, he ōna papa paku e uhi taka ana. He tahuri tino tere i tōna wāhi noa.

80.body: He noke papatahi tino iti a Macrostomum lignano. He uaua ā-tinana, he karu tūturu. He tauira mō te oranga anō. Ka kaihoro i ngā protist iti.

81.body: He noke tīwaiwai makawe a Stenostomum leucops. Ka wehe mā te hāngai, ka noho hei rārangi zooid. He kaihoro parapara me ngā kararehe iti.

82.body: He noke papatahi a Microstomum lineare; ka kai i te hydra, ā, ka whakatō i ōna ngira poke ki tōna kiri ake. He rārangi zooid.

83.body: He nemertean wai māori a Prostoma graecense. He arero roa ka whiu tere atu ki te kai. He kaihoro nui noa o te papa, he mea uaua te kite.

84.body: He placozoan a Trichoplax adhaerens, tētahi o ngā kararehe māmā rawa. Ka neke hei rapa papatahi, ā, ka nakunaku i te kai i waho o te tinana. Kāore he waha.

85.body: He pē parāoa a Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Ka whānau tētahi pēpi iti i ōna taha, ka kai huka, ka tuku i te CO2 me te waipiro. I te roto, ka horoi i ngā matū hangaora kua rea.

86.body: He pē a Candida albicans, ka taea te tipu hei taura. Ina he ngoikore te tangata, ka whakaputa mate. I te kēmu, he harore parapara tēnei.

87.body: He harore parāoa a Mucor mucedo. He sporangia ki runga pou, he tipu tere ki runga i ngā mea mate. Kāore e kaihoro i ngā mea ora.

88.body: He harore parāoa mangu a Rhizopus stolonifer. Ko ngā stolon me ngā rhizoid e hora ana i te pūtake. Ka whati i te warowaiā.

89.body: He harore a Penicillium chrysogenum, ko te puna o te penicillin. He taura konidia. Ka whakangaro i ngā matū hangaora, ā, ka pēhia ngā huakita o te tata.

90.body: He aspergillus mangu a Aspergillus niger. He upoko spore porohita. He kaihanga citric-acid ā-ahumahi. He kai parapara noa.

91.body: He chytrid a Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis nō ngā pepeketua. He zoospore kotahi whiore. I te roto, he tauira mō te harore wai.

92.body: He chytrid wai a Chytriomyces aureus i runga i te puehu puawai me ngā rimurapa. He sporangia kōwhai; ka kau ngā zoospore ki te pūtake.

93.body: He harore wai a Allomyces macrogynus, he mycelium tūturu tōna. Ka whakawhitiwa i waenganui i te diploid me te haploid. He whiore tūauru ōna zoospore.

94.body: He huakita oneone a Bacillus subtilis, he pūtau roa. Ka ora ōna spore i te wai e koropupū ana. Ka whati i te pūmua; he tauira Gram-positive.

95.body: He huakita horoi a Pseudomonas putida. Ka kai anō i ngā hua petroleum. He whiore, ka tere te tipu i runga i te parapara.

96.body: He huakita oneone taura a Streptomyces coelicolor. Ka hanga i te kakara oneone (geosmin) me ngā antibiotic maha. He spore ki runga i te hyphae.

97.body: Ka whati i te cellulose a Cellulomonas fimi. He pūtau kōwhai ki runga i te parapara tipu. Me kore tēnei, ka roa ake te noho o ngā rimurapa mate.

98.body: He thermophile a Thermus aquaticus nō ngā puna wai wera. Ko te Taq polymerase te pūtake o te PCR. I te roto makariri, tae noa ki te moe noa ia.

99.body: He toa iraruke a Deinococcus radiodurans. Ka whakatika anō i tētahi genome kua whatiwhati i roto i ngā haora noa iho. He taiepa mātōtoru, he kāhui whā pūtau.

1001.body: Ko te Sexual Eukaryote he tauira ako mō te whakawhānau ā-taha. E rua ngā taha (tāne/uwha), ka tūhonohono ngā gamete; ehara ko te wehe-rua noa iho.

T4 Bacteriophage.body: He myovirus nui a T4 o te E. coli. Ka kukune te whiore, ka whakauru i te DNA. I roto i te hawhe haora, ka pakaru te pūtau, ka puta mai ngā phage maha.

Lambda Phage.body: He phage mahaki a Lambda. Ka taea te kuhu ki roto i te chromosome, ka moe (lysogeny), rānei ka whakapakaru i te pūtau i te wā kotahi (lysis).

T7 Bacteriophage.body: He whiore poto tō T7, he tere rawa atu ōna whakapūruatanga. He tino pai tēnei pūnaha mō te biology hangahanga.

Phi-6 Phage.body: He phage RNA a Phi-6 me tētahi kiri lipid. Ka pokenga i te Pseudomonas. He kiri pūnoa rawa mō tētahi phage.

MS2 Phage.body: He phage RNA tino iti a MS2, kāore he whiore. Ka piri ki ngā pili o te E. coli tāne. Ko tōna genome tētahi o ngā genome RNA tuatahi i pānuihia.

Neuro-Parasite.body: He kainoho roro pūrākau nō te roto. Ka piri ki ngā eukaryote, ka whakararu i te whanonga o te kaiwhakaruruhau, tae noa ki te kaiwhakaruruhau ka puta hei kaiwhakawhiti.

Sexual Eukaryote.body: Ko te Sexual Eukaryote he tauira ako mō te whakawhānau ā-taha. E rua ngā taha (tāne/uwha), ka tūhonohono ngā gamete; ehara ko te wehe-rua noa iho.
